convert_dataset_to_coco_json: convert a detectron2 registered dataset to COCO format JSON and save to an output file
create_COCOEvaluator_for_bbox_segm_keypo: create a COCOEvaluator instance to evaluate bbox, segmentation, or keypoint detection tasks on a dataset
run_COCOEvaluator_evaluate: run the COCOEvaluator evaluate method to compute AP metrics and return results as an OrderedDict
convert_instances_to_coco_json: convert detectron2 Instances objects to COCO-format JSON annotations for a given image ID
evaluate_box_proposals_recall: evaluate detection proposal recall metrics using pairwise IoU against ground truth boxes with area filtering
